newsitem.title: USA: Bay State Gas LNG project cleared.
newsitem.headline: Bay State Gas LNG project cleared.

text.p: Bay State Gas Co said Maine's Board of Environmental Protection last week approved state environmental permits for the Wells LNG project proposed by the company's Granite State Gas Transmission Inc subsidiary.
It noted the ruling comes after the $50 million project received approval from utility regulators in both Maine and New Hampshire.

Although construction was originally expected to begin this fall in order to have the facility in operation by November 1998, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission recently announced it would extend its environmental review for several months. As a result, the in-service date of the project is expected to be delayed by one year, Bay State said.
